headline: Royal Mail Viability Threatened by Market Undercutting, Ex-Minister Warns
summary: A former UK business secretary warned that Royal Mail risks becoming unviable unless the government acts to address aggressive price undercutting by competing parcel carriers.
why: Royal Mail is the designated universal postal service provider in the UK, operating under regulatory oversight while competing with private logistics networks.

impacts.name: Royal Mail
impacts.why: Royal Mail faces growing commercial pressures that could jeopardize its long-term viability.
